modelDescription: The HIT Pro M3 has the smoothest production action available. Period. With the redesigned M3 action and bolt body, 60-degree throw, and integrating all the features that made the HIT Pro such a success, the HIT Pro M3 is Seekins' next step in innovation in our relentless pursuit of precision.
